name: Range
summary: A native range slider with a drawn track and thumb, for picking a value where the exact number matters less than the position.
description: Show the current value next to the label in an <output>, and the ends of the scale underneath when they help. If people need an exact number, use a number input or a stepper instead.

classes.name: v-range
classes.description: The slider. Firefox also fills the track before the thumb.

classes.name: v-range-label
classes.description: A row above the slider: the label at the start, the current value (<output>) at the end.

states.description: The native scale; the browser does the maths and the keyboard steps.

keyboard.action: Lowers the value by one step.
Raises the value by one step.
Jumps to the minimum or maximum.

a11y: Give the slider a <label for>; the <output for> shows the value but does not label it.
When the raw number means little (a price, a level), set aria-valuetext so screen readers hear "€600" rather than "600".
The track uses the control border colour so it holds 3:1 against the page, and the focus ring goes round the whole slider.

examples.title: With value and scale
examples.description: The value in the <output> is kept in step by a few lines of script.
